verdict.rationale: Proa templates are Rust macros that are validated at compile time with typed dynamic slots (proa-gh-2), and component props passed in templates are compile-time-checked (proa-docs-32). Editor tooling provides Rust hover, completion, and rename inside `md!` templates (proa-docs-26), and missing fields are flagged across paired views (proa-docs-27), so checking extends into templates rather than stopping at script code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that arbitrary expressions inside HTML templates are fully type-checked, editor support evidenced beyond `md!` templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
